rows.grounds: numeral compound indicating the number eighty-four
locative plural expressing location within a multitude
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural
past passive participle indicating those subjected to affliction

items.question: In how many womb-mechanisms are beings said to undergo torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Therefore, beings undergo torment within eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The specific subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly named in this verse and relies on context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
